page.overview:
What is Unidentified freighter company?

A small company sold freighters. the mother of the Rodians Reezo and Tsuulo worked for the company as a sales rep while the family lived on Coruscant. Her work often took her offworld. On one occasion, after she had won a big sales bonus, the woman decided to take her husband, Reezo, and Tsuulo with her on one of her business trips—a sales conference at the Buckell Center in Coronet City on the Core Worlds planet Corellia. On the second morning of the conference, both parents were inadvertently killed by a Besalisk factory worker when he swerved off a road and hit them. That year, Tsuulo, now a scrumrat in the White Worms criminal organization on Corellia, mentioned the freighter company and his mother's employment within it to fellow scrumrats Han and Qi'ra.

The freighter company was mentioned in the 2018 young-adult novel Most Wanted, written by Rae Carson.
